findings.message: POST_NOTIFICATIONS declared; runtime flow required on API 33+.
canRetrieveWindowContent should stay false unless semantic node actions are required.

Thread.sleep blocks the accessibility binder thread; use coroutine delay. — [ALLOW] Sleeper.BLOCKING is the single sanctioned blocking pause in the codebase: the AccessibilityService invokes graph execution on Dispatchers.Default (never main), interruption restores the thread flag, and all engines/tests consume the Sleeper port instead of Thread.sleep directly.
